# debezium_postgres_connector (Data Source)

Looks up an existing Debezium PostgreSQL outbox connector by name.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the connector in Kafka Connect.

### Read-Only

- `aws_msk_iam` (Boolean) True when the connector authenticates the schema-history Kafka client using AWS MSK IAM.
- `database_dbname` (String) PostgreSQL database name being captured.
- `database_hostname` (String) PostgreSQL server hostname.
- `database_password` (String, Sensitive) PostgreSQL replication user password.
- `database_port` (Number) PostgreSQL server port.
- `database_server_name` (String) Logical name identifying the PostgreSQL server/cluster, used as a topic prefix.
- `database_user` (String) PostgreSQL replication user.
- `decimal_handling_mode` (String) How `DECIMAL`/`NUMERIC` columns are represented in change events.
- `extra_config` (Map of String) Always empty for looked-up connectors: there is no way to tell which config keys, if any, were originally set through a resource's `extra_config` escape hatch.
- `heartbeat_interval_ms` (Number) Interval in milliseconds at which the connector sends heartbeat messages.
- `id` (String) Connector identifier (same value as `name`).
- `max_batch_size` (Number) Maximum size of a batch processed by the connector.
- `max_queue_size` (Number) Maximum size of the connector's internal change event queue.
- `message_key_columns` (String) Semicolon-separated list of `schema.table:column1,column2` expressions overriding the message key for specific tables.
- `outbox_route_by_field` (String) Outbox table column used to route events to a topic.
- `outbox_route_topic_replacement` (String) Topic name replacement pattern for the outbox event router.
- `outbox_table_field_event_key` (String) Outbox table column used as the outgoing record key.
- `outbox_table_field_event_timestamp` (String) Outbox table column used as the outgoing record timestamp.
- `outbox_table_fields_additional_placement` (String) Additional outbox column-to-header/envelope placement mappings.
- `plugin_name` (String) PostgreSQL logical decoding plug-in.
- `publication_autocreate_mode` (String) How the PostgreSQL publication is created when using `pgoutput`.
- `sasl_scram` (Attributes) Set when the connector authenticates the schema-history Kafka client with SASL/SCRAM-SHA-512. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--sasl_scram))
- `schema_history_kafka_bootstrap_servers` (String) Comma-separated Kafka bootstrap servers used by the schema-history client.
- `schema_history_kafka_topic` (String) Kafka topic used to store the database schema history.
- `security_protocol` (String) Security protocol used by the schema-history Kafka client.
- `slot_drop_on_stop` (Boolean) Whether the logical replication slot is dropped when the connector stops.
- `slot_name` (String) Name of the PostgreSQL logical replication slot.
- `snapshot_mode` (String) Snapshotting behavior on first startup.
- `table_include_list` (String) Comma-separated list of `schema.table` regexes being captured.
- `tombstones_on_delete` (Boolean) Whether a tombstone event is emitted after a delete event.

<a id="nestedatt--sasl_scram"></a>
### Nested Schema for `sasl_scram`

Read-Only:

- `password` (String, Sensitive) SASL/SCRAM password.
- `username` (String) SASL/SCRAM username.
